html:
Romania is a country on the lower Danube and the Black Sea, with a Romance language descended from Latin. On the map it appears from 1880 to the present.

It was born from two principalities under Ottoman overlordship, Moldavia and Wallachia. In 1859 both chose the same prince, Alexandru Ioan Cuza, and soon formed one state. Romania fought beside Russia in the Russo-Turkish War of 1877 to 1878, and the Congress of Berlin recognised its full independence. It became a kingdom under Carol I in 1881.

Its shape changed with the wars:

  • In 1918, after joining the Allies in the First World War, it gained Transylvania from Austria-Hungary, plus Bessarabia and Bukovina. This was "Greater Romania", about double its old size.
  • In 1940 it lost land to the Soviet Union, Hungary and Bulgaria. It fought on Germany's side in the Second World War until it switched sides in August 1944.
  • After the war it fell under Soviet control and became a communist state.

From 1965 Nicolae Ceaușescu ruled with a growing cult of personality. He kept some distance from Moscow, but in the 1980s he paid off foreign debts by cutting food and heat at home. In December 1989 the Romanian Revolution overthrew him; he was shot after a short trial. Romania joined NATO in 2004 and the European Union in 2007. Many Romanians have since gone west to work.
sum: Romania is a country on the lower Danube and the Black Sea, with a Romance language descended from Latin. On the map it appears from 1880 to the present.
